name: github-actions
// why: Nx lint targets are per-project, and .github/actions belonged to no project -- so both gates that matter (ci.yml's `pnpm lint`, and the pre-push hook's `nx affected -t lint`) skipped every composite action's JavaScript. Nothing was ignoring it; nobody was asking for it. The dispatch broker has since moved to apps/dispatch-broker; published-actions.contract.test.mjs (run directly by ci.yml, not through Nx) remains here, and this project is what keeps it linted. credential-grant, the last loose test script this project's own `test` target ran, was deleted in #1015 Wave 4 (it was never live -- see docs/published-actions.md), so that target was removed too.
